By clustering addresses based on their activity patterns at emission time, the network can pay each cluster a single reward, effectively raising the cost for an attacker to create multiple fake identities. This approach hits the attacker at their nadir, where the cost of creating and maintaining numerous identities becomes prohibitively expensive.
